------------------------------- Life-Cycle ----------------------------- #\n    async def start(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Kick-off background tasks (remote listener).\"\"\"\n        if self._running:  # ------------------------------- Internals ----------------------------- #\n    async def _attempt_sync(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Try to push local changes to the remote gateway.\"\"\"\n        if not self._unsynced_changes:\n            return\n\n        try:\n            await self.gateway.push_profile(self.user_id, dict(self.local_profile))\n            self._unsynced_changes = False\n        except NetworkError:\n            # across two distinct services:\n\n1. **ProfileService** (`flockdesk/core/services/profile_service.py`):\n   - Managed static user data: name, username, avatar, preferences, layout\n   - Handled local persistence and cloud synchronization\n   - Published events on `profile/updated` topic\n\n2. **PresenceService** (`flockdesk/modules/presence/service.py`):\n   - Managed dynamic real-time data: online/away/dnd/offline status\n   - Implemented idle detection and heartbeat publishing\n   - Published events on `presence.updated` topic\n\n### Issues with Original Architecture\n- Components needing complete user view had to interact with two different services\n- Risk of data inconsistency between profile and presence states\n- Increased coupling and complexity in consumer components\n- Difficult to maintain a coherent user state across the application\n\n### Solution Design\n\nThe new **UserService** consolidates both services into a single source of truth:\n\n1. **Data Model Unification**:\n   - `UserProfile` dataclass combines static profile fields with presence fields\n   - `PresenceInfo` for event-bus communication of status changes\n   - `PresenceState` enum for valid status values\n\n2. **Unified API**:\n   - `get_user_view(user_id)` - Returns complete user data (profile + presence)\n   - `get_all_users()` - Returns views for all known users\n   - Profile methods: `get_current_user_profile()`, `save()`, `update_preferences()`\n   - Presence methods: `set_status()`, `get_presence()`, `observe_user_status()`\n\n3. **Lifecycle Management**:\n   - `start()` / `stop()` - Controls sync threads and presence broadcasting\n   - `start_async()` / `stop_async()` - For async presence tasks\n\n4. **Event Bus Integration**:\n   - Subscribes to `profile/refresh`, `presence.updated`, `user/updated`\n   - Publishes `profile/updated` and `presence.updated` events\n   - Maintains backwards compatibility with existing event consumers\n\n### Consumer Updates\n\nAll consumer components were updated to optionally accept a `user_service` parameter:\n- **PresenceViewModel**: Can now bootstrap roster from UserService\n- **PresenceWidget**: Integrates with UserService for initial data\n- **AvatarWidget**: Loads avatar and presence from UserService\n\nThese updates maintain backwards compatibility - components work without UserService by falling back to event-bus subscriptions.\n\n## Implementation\n\n### Files Created:\n1. `/app/project/flockdesk/core/services/user_service.py` - 560+ lines, unified service implementation\n\n### Files Modified:\n1. across two distinct services:\n\n1. **ProfileService** (`flockdesk/core/services/profile_service.py`):\n   - Managed static user data: name, username, avatar, preferences, layout\n   - Handled local persistence and cloud synchronization\n   - Published events on `profile/updated` topic\n\n2. **PresenceService** (`flockdesk/modules/presence/service.py`):\n   - Managed dynamic real-time data: online/away/dnd/offline status\n   - Implemented idle detection and heartbeat publishing\n   - Published events on `presence.updated` topic\n\n### Issues with Original Architecture\n- Components needing complete user view had to interact with two different services\n- Risk of data inconsistency between profile and presence states\n- Increased coupling and complexity in consumer components\n- Difficult to maintain a coherent user state across the application\n\n### Solution Design\n\nThe new **UserService** consolidates both services into a single source of truth:\n\n1. **Data Model Unification**:\n   - `UserProfile` dataclass combines static profile fields with presence fields\n   - `PresenceInfo` for event-bus communication of status changes\n   - `PresenceState` enum for valid status values\n\n2. **Unified API**:\n   - `get_user_view(user_id)` - Returns complete user data (profile + presence)\n   - `get_all_users()` - Returns views for all known users\n   - Profile methods: `get_current_user_profile()`, `save()`, `update_preferences()`\n   - Presence methods: `set_status()`, `get_presence()`, `observe_user_status()`\n\n3. **Lifecycle Management**:\n   - `start()` / `stop()` - Controls sync threads and presence broadcasting\n   - `start_async()` / `stop_async()` - For async presence tasks\n\n4. **Event Bus Integration**:\n   - Subscribes to `profile/refresh`, `presence.updated`, `user/updated`\n   - Publishes `profile/updated` and `presence.updated` events\n   - Maintains backwards compatibility with existing event consumers\n\n### Consumer Updates\n\nAll consumer components were updated to optionally accept a `user_service` parameter:\n- **PresenceViewModel**: Can now bootstrap roster from UserService\n- **PresenceWidget**: Integrates with UserService for initial data\n- **AvatarWidget**: Loads avatar and presence from UserService\n\nThese updates maintain backwards compatibility - components work without UserService by falling back to event-bus subscriptions.\n\n## Implementation\n\n### Files Created:\n1. `/app/project/flockdesk/core/services/user_service.py` - 560+ lines, unified service implementation\n\n### Files Modified:\n1. across two distinct services:\n\n1. **ProfileService** (`flockdesk/core/services/profile_service.py`):\n   - Managed static user data: name, username, avatar, preferences, layout\n   - Handled local persistence and cloud synchronization\n   - Published events on `profile/updated` topic\n\n2. **PresenceService** (`flockdesk/modules/presence/service.py`):\n   - Managed dynamic real-time data: online/away/dnd/offline status\n   - Implemented idle detection and heartbeat publishing\n   - Published events on `presence.updated` topic\n\n### Issues with Original Architecture\n- Components needing complete user view had to interact with two different services\n- Risk of data inconsistency between profile and presence states\n- Increased coupling and complexity in consumer components\n- Difficult to maintain a coherent user state across the application\n\n### Solution Design\n\nThe new **UserService** consolidates both services into a single source of truth:\n\n1. **Data Model Unification**:\n   - `UserProfile` dataclass combines static profile fields with presence fields\n   - `PresenceInfo` for event-bus communication of status changes\n   - `PresenceState` enum for valid status values\n\n2. **Unified API**:\n   - `get_user_view(user_id)` - Returns complete user data (profile + presence)\n   - `get_all_users()` - Returns views for all known users\n   - Profile methods: `get_current_user_profile()`, `save()`, `update_preferences()`\n   - Presence methods: `set_status()`, `get_presence()`, `observe_user_status()`\n\n3. **Lifecycle Management**:\n   - `start()` / `stop()` - Controls sync threads and presence broadcasting\n   - `start_async()` / `stop_async()` - For async presence tasks\n\n4. **Event Bus Integration**:\n   - Subscribes to `profile/refresh`, `presence.updated`, `user/updated`\n   - Publishes `profile/updated` and `presence.updated` events\n   - Maintains backwards compatibility with existing event consumers\n\n### Consumer Updates\n\nAll consumer components were updated to optionally accept a `user_service` parameter:\n- **PresenceViewModel**: Can now bootstrap roster from UserService\n- **PresenceWidget**: Integrates with UserService for initial data\n- **AvatarWidget**: Loads avatar and presence from UserService\n\nThese updates maintain backwards compatibility - components work without UserService by falling back to event-bus subscriptions.\n\n## Implementation\n\n### Files Created:\n1. `/app/project/flockdesk/core/services/user_service.py` - 560+ lines, unified service implementation\n\n### Files Modified:\n1.
